text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls).

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key changes observed at 20:00 (both residents home):

Entry:
- Aisha’s items (backpack, headphones, jacket, keys, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, shoes, wallet, water bottle) returned to entry hooks/table/floor at 20:00.
- Felix’s items (backpack, charger, headphones, jacket, laptop, scarf, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle) returned to entry hooks/table/floor/shoe rack at 20:00.
- Shared: toolbox, vacuum cleaner on floor.

Kitchen:
- Counter: kettle, knife block, toaster, wall clock, vitamins (Felix).
- Cupboard: duster, glass (Aisha), plate (Aisha), bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), mug (Felix), plate (Felix).
- Table: fruit bowl, glass (Felix), cutting board, plate (Felix), serving dish, water bottle (Felix).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, mug (Aisha), pan, kitchen knife.
- Dish rack: glass (Aisha).
- Drawer: empty.
- Pantry: shopping bag, spatula.

Living:
- Couch: blanket, cushion 1, knitting bag (Felix).
- Coffee table: candle, coasters, tissue box, remote.
- Bookshelf: board game, picture frame, speaker, vase.
- TV stand: empty.
- Side table: lamp.
- Armchair: cushion 2.

Bedroom 1:
- Nightstand: books (Aisha, Felix), glasses (Aisha), tablets (Aisha, Felix).
- Desk: laptop (Aisha).
- Dresser: hair dryer (Felix).
- Floor: ironing board.
- Bed/Wardrobe: empty.

Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent, laundry basket, skincare (Aisha, Felix), toiletry bag (Felix).
- Medicine cabinet: medication (Aisha).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, razor (Felix), razor (Aisha).
- Towel rack: towels (Aisha, Felix).

Balcony:
- Floor: watering can.
- Table: spray bottle, gardening gloves.

Office:
- All spots empty.

Notes:
- Aisha’s work/errand items (laptop, bag, keys, etc.) are typically out during the day and returned to entry by evening.
- Felix’s work items (laptop, bag, keys) follow a similar pattern.
- Kitchen utensils (knife, spatula, cutting board) move between drawer/counter/sink/table during meal prep/cleanup.
- Shared dishes (plates, pans, serving dishes) move from cupboard to table during meals.
- Water bottles appear in kitchen/entry when residents are home.
- Phones are not tracked in patrols (likely in pockets/bags).
- Remote moves between TV stand and coffee table.
- Razors move between shelf and sink.
- Tablets move between nightstand and kitchen table.
